title: I let GPT play my time-travel stock market demo before next week's Steam launch (75s clip)
author: Gasfard96
selftext:
I'm the developer of Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator. 

Before launching next week, I let GPT SOL 6.1(High) play the demo and recorded it exploring the story, reading historical news, comparing companies and making investment choices. This is a 75-second edit and Full AI Play and AI Play Highlights are on Youtube.

Full AI Play: [https://youtu.be/Pj-fl8VcwhI](https://youtu.be/Pj-fl8VcwhI)  
AI Play highlights: [https://youtu.be/N1zJojMy0pI](https://youtu.be/N1zJojMy0pI)

The free Windows demo is available now. Full release: November 5, 2026 at 4 PM PST / November 6 at 00:00 UTC.

Steam demo and wishlist: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5119690/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=organic\_social&utm\_campaign=release\_20261106&utm\_content=20261030\_aigamedev\_75s](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5119690/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=release_20261106&utm_content=20261030_aigamedev_75s)
